intent: Stylized walk-in-place loop with alternating high knee lifts; the upper body and both arms change pose with the stepping rhythm.

phases.description: The left-leg lift continues across the loop seam, reaches its high-knee peak at f10, then lowers into the low-pelvis region at f31.
Step transition; the right leg moves out of its lower excursion while the pelvis shifts toward its -Y extreme.
The right leg lifts, reaches its high-knee peak at f78, then lowers into the second low-pelvis region at f103.
Step transition into the next left-leg lift, closing the loop back toward f0. The f138-to-f0 seam occurs during the left-leg lift rather than at a natural contact boundary.

keyPoses.role: first downshift; pelvis reaches its lowest Z position
second downshift; pelvis reaches a local low point

weightTransfer: The pelvis follows a broad -X -> -Y -> +X -> +Y path before returning near its starting position, while also bobbing along Z. This is used as a pelvis/hips weight-shift proxy; no support foot is assigned because the source does not provide sufficient contact flags or world-space foot positions for exact support/contact timing.
bodyMechanics: The two main torso pulses repeat the same timing order: hips reach a rotation extreme around canonical X first, Spine follows, then Chest/Shoulders follow (f13 -> f25 -> f26 and f85 -> f90 -> f100).
